parsed.explanation: Thin trans-specific data, so rating extrapolates from structural signals. Same-sex law is secondary, but here it is not a dead letter: 2024 faction courts sentenced >40 people to death by stoning/crucifixion, flogging or imprisonment, with no recorded reversal. 'Breach of modesty' laws reaching public presentation provide a documented lever against gender-nonconforming expression. The law is invoked to license vigilante violence, society is described as having no place for known gay/trans people, and erosion of rule of law plus militia influence leaves no recourse or official protection. Failure to document trans-specific facility, border or custody rules is absence of evidence, not safety, in this hostile, non-protective regime.
